decisions.raw: 전투 당 1회 처음 파쇄가 3까지 쌓인 적을 향한 공격은 중복으로 무효처리 되지 않음.

confirmedRule.effect: Prevent collision-based invalidation of the attack against the enemy identified by the first Shatter 3 threshold occurrence.

decisions.interpretationBoundary: The CLOSEOUT request explicitly resolves the target to the owner's attack. Remaining deterministic reservation ordering is BETA_V02_INFERRED in the final contract.

closeoutIntegration.deterministicReservation: First owner's subsequent primary attack against the firstShatter3enemy; one owner primary card per root. Root retries reuse same reservation.
closeoutIntegration.reservationConsumption: Consume on that first attack whether or not it collides; protection suppresses only collision invalidation.

confirmedRule.simultaneousCreation: Each Vampire independently computes its target from the same collision result; another owner's mark does not exclude that target.
confirmedRule.reconnectRule: Restore the persisted owner/target relationship without reselection.

confirmedRule.sourceLevelCap: Apply an existing source-defined level cap if present; this patch introduces no level cap.
perLevelUp: Increase Ghost Slash level by 1 subject to an existing source cap.
Rearm Ghost Slash if already used and inactive.
confirmedRule.idempotencyRule: Do not apply the same atomic Devour gain more than once.

confirmedRule.illegalSubmissionRule: Reject at the server before submission; later number modification cannot legalize an illegal printed card.
confirmedRule.finalNumberParityRule: A parity change after legal submission does not invalidate the submitted card.
confirmedRule.recoveryRule: Recovery ignores parity and preserves cardInstanceId; later selection rechecks current required parity against printed number.
confirmedRule.acrobaticsRule: A parity flip immediately updates selection validation.
confirmedRule.reconnectRule: Restore persisted required parity and cycle state without reseeding or rerolling.
confirmedRule.specialIntegerRule: Use ordinary integer parity, including 0 and 6, when explicitly present in the Twins pool; an explicit augment override takes precedence.

availability.normalUse: Consume the owner's mark; unavailable until a new mark is obtained.
availability.legacyOncePerCycleLimit: The user-confirmed availability model supersedes a conflicting independent once-per-cycle Blood Command restriction. The aug-303 reserve acquisition limit remains once per cycle.

reserve.effect: Defer consumption of one mark for one Blood Command use; the following additional use normally consumes that mark.

aug303.trigger: Blood Command was used and both the owner and that root action's Thrall are finally VALID.
aug303.eligibleMark: A NEW Thrall mark acquired after this reserve was earned.

aug308.damageApplication: One bonusDamage component attached to that eligible attack; no extra submissions or one hit per stack.
aug308.firstEligibleAttack: Next distinct eligible primary attack after the Blood Command root resolution has ended; never the already resolving attack in that command turn.

confirmedRule.sourcePrecedenceNote: With aug-308, persistent non-consumed Dominance overrides conflicting Q10/older consume-then-gain mechanics. Q10 remains the reference outside this explicit override.

confirmedRule.trigger: Blood Command was actually used and the owner's exchanged card would be invalidated by final collision.
confirmedRule.effect: Suppress only that card's collision-based invalidation; pass as VALID if no other invalid reason applies.
confirmedRule.idempotencyRule: Consume protection at most once for the same rootAction.
confirmedRule.replacesConflictingBetaEffect: Incoming direct damage reduction by 1 is not the runtime meaning.

pools.higherOverride: An explicitly specified higher override such as aug-358 takes precedence.

confirmedRule.normalCycleRule: Do not park or restore the previous normal cycle's spent/remaining cards. End and replace that cycle.
confirmedRule.exitCondition: All transformed physical cards have been used.

exitDevour.override: Explicit exit rules such as aug-357 take precedence.

confirmedRule.scopeException: The aug-351 transformation archetype's explicit combat-end Devour reset overrides D03 RUN carry for this archetype; D03 remains the general Devour rule.
confirmedRule.legacySemanticReplacement: Replaces automatic turn-end transformation and any proposed suspended-normal-pool restoration.

decisionIdentityRule: Use ruleId as canonical identity. User-provided D02-D04 labels refer to the topics recorded here, not the differently worded prior questions.

resolvedPriorQuestions.reason: The new D02 confirms mark ownership, but does not define Blood Command cooldown/additional-use semantics.
The new D03 confirms Devour overflow, but does not choose between collision validity protection and incoming-damage mitigation.
The new D04 confirms Twins input eligibility, but does not specify manual versus automatic transformation activation.

readinessNote: D01-D07 and the CLOSEOUT target/ordering clarifications are reflected by final120 contracts. readyForRuntime in this source artifact remains false because this file records decisions only; final acceptance is gated by audit/validator and exact-head Project Checks in PR24.
